commit d3d84ec6b02306eddb8d09c9e7876f045e060ac3
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Sat May 30 15:28:10 2026 -0600
Commit:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sat May 30 15:28:10 2026 -0600

    Bug 2043536 - Improve wording for user facing strings related to Experiment deprecation on Release. r=tobyp,aleca
    
    
    Based on feedback from the community:
    https://thunderbird.topicbox.com/groups/addons/T5426c1d2b0ba520c/disabling-experiment-apis-on-the-release-channel-plan-for-thunderbird-153
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D303304

diff --git a/mail/base/content/aboutAddonsExtra.js b/mail/base/content/aboutAddonsExtra.js
index be660c9d162..4c93b7cb9fb 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/aboutAddonsExtra.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/aboutAddonsExtra.js
@@ -78,7 +78,7 @@ function getBrowserElement() {
           linkUrl: `${alternativeAddonSearchUrl}?id=${encodeURIComponent(
             addon.id
           )}&q=${encodeURIComponent(name)}&isSuppressed=true`,
-          messageId: "details-notification-suppressed-esr",
+          messageId: "details-notification-suppressed-esr-2",
           messageArgs: { name },
           type: "warning",
         };
diff --git a/mail/base/content/messenger.xhtml b/mail/base/content/messenger.xhtml
index e4242afb6f2..01cc4de8b44 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/messenger.xhtml
+++ b/mail/base/content/messenger.xhtml
@@ -444,7 +444,7 @@
 
   <popupnotification id="addon-webext-expsuppressed-notification" hasicon="true" hidden="hidden">
     <popupnotificationcontent class="addon-webext-expsuppressed-notification-content" orient="vertical">
-      <description data-l10n-id="webext-install-suppressed-details" class="addon-webext-expsuppressed-text"/>
+      <description data-l10n-id="webext-install-suppressed-details-2" class="addon-webext-expsuppressed-text"/>
       <hbox>
         <label data-l10n-id="webext-perms-learn-more" id="addon-webext-expsuppressed-info" is="text-link" class="popup-notification-learnmore-link"/>
       </hbox>
diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/aboutAddonsExtra.ftl b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/aboutAddonsExtra.ftl
index 6f79c950a6f..9634340eb99 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/aboutAddonsExtra.ftl
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/aboutAddonsExtra.ftl
@@ -16,5 +16,5 @@ atn-addons-heading-search-button =
     .title = Search addons.thunderbird.net
     .aria-label = Search addons.thunderbird.net
 
-details-notification-suppressed-esr =
-    .message = The add-on was disabled because it uses Experiment APIs. These APIs are limited to { -brand-product-name } ESR and are not supported in this version of { -brand-product-name }.
+details-notification-suppressed-esr-2 =
+    .message = The add-on was disabled because it uses legacy APIs. Add-ons with legacy APIs can modify every part of { -brand-product-name } and need to be updated, reviewed and approved whenever { -brand-product-name } itself changes. Such add-ons are therefore not supported by this version of { -brand-product-name }, but only by { -brand-product-name } ESR, which receives fewer code changes and stays stable throughout the 1-year ESR cycle.
diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/extensionsUI.ftl b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/extensionsUI.ftl
index f0db9fe0e9b..03887a24a4f 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/extensionsUI.ftl
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/extensionsUI.ftl
@@ -6,10 +6,12 @@ webext-experiment-warning = Malicious add-ons can steal your private information
 
 webext-perms-learn-more = Learn more
 
-webext-install-suppressed-message = The <> add-on could not be installed because it uses Experiment APIs, which are not supported by this version of Thunderbird.
+# The "<>" is a placeholder for the add-on name, used by toolkit code which has
+# not yet been updated to use fluent placeholders.
+webext-install-suppressed-message-2 = The <> add-on could not be installed because it uses legacy APIs, which are not supported by this version of { -brand-product-name }.
 
-webext-install-suppressed-details = Add-ons with Experiment APIs are only supported on { -brand-product-name } ESR.
+webext-install-suppressed-details-2 = Add-ons with legacy APIs can modify every part of { -brand-product-name } and need to be updated, reviewed and approved whenever { -brand-product-name } itself changes. These legacy APIs are therefore only supported by { -brand-product-name } ESR, which receives fewer code changes and stays stable throughout the 1-year ESR cycle.
 
 # Variables:
-#   $addonName (String): localized named of the extension that was just installed.
+#   $addonName (String): localized name of the extension that was just installed.
 addon-post-install-message = { $addonName } was added.
diff --git a/mail/modules/ExtensionsUI.sys.mjs b/mail/modules/ExtensionsUI.sys.mjs
index be547eea17a..6de74cf9f59 100644
--- a/mail/modules/ExtensionsUI.sys.mjs
+++ b/mail/modules/ExtensionsUI.sys.mjs
@@ -813,7 +813,7 @@ var gXPInstallObserver = {
         // name.
         options.name = install.addon.name;
         const messageString = lazy.l10n.formatValueSync(
-          "webext-install-suppressed-message"
+          "webext-install-suppressed-message-2"
         );
 
         PopupNotifications.show(
